step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows data ingested from on-premises sources via AWS Direct Connect to Database Migration Service (DMS). DMS writes data to both DynamoDB (staging layer with RAW, L1, L2) and S3 (raw archive). DynamoDB Streams trigger Lambda functions to process and push enriched data across layers. In case of error recovery, Athena queries S3 data to rebuild layers and push back into DynamoDB.
